    NULL                                                     AS sector,
    NULL                                                     AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
    NULL                                                     AS funded_amount,
    NULL                                                     AS quantity_net,
    NULL                                                     AS maturity,
    NULL                                                     AS market_value,
    NULL                                                     AS portfolio_name,
    NULL                                                     AS sentry_security_type,
    securities.price_multiplier                              AS price_multiplier,
    securities.quantity_multiplier                           AS quantity_multiplier,
    NULL                                                     AS debt_factor,
    NULL                                                     AS model_portfolio_id,
    transactions.txn_id                                      AS ticket_number,
    --------------------------------------
    -- fixed-values specified in BRD
    --------------------------------------
    80                                                       AS probability_of_close,
    NULL                                                     AS binding,
    NULL                                                     AS capital_usage_component,
    NULL                                                     AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
    NULL                                                     AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
    --------------------------------------
    -- 'expected'-related fields
    --------------------------------------
    transactions.settlement_date                             AS expected_funding_date,
    transactions.trade_date                                  AS expected_trade_date,
    NULL                                                     AS expected_exit_price,
    NULL                                                     AS expected_exit_probability,
    NULL                                                     AS expected_exit_date,
    transactions.total_amount_local                          AS expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,

    --------------------------------------

    --------------------------------------
    -- created by and updated by fields
    --------------------------------------
    NULL                                                     AS last_updated_by,
    NULL                                                     AS last_updated_date,
    NULL                                                     AS created_by_user_group,
    NULL                                                     AS created_by,
    NULL                                                     AS date_updated,
    --------------------------------------
    -- source business dates
    --------------------------------------
    transactions.business_date                               AS sentry_transactions_src_business_date,
    securities.business_date                                 AS sentry_security_src_business_date,
    --------------------------------------
    -- comment and error
    --------------------------------------
    NULL                                                     AS comment,
    NULL                                                     AS error,
    --------------------------------------
    -- null on purpose (from requirements)
    --------------------------------------
    NULL                                                     AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
    NULL                                                     AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
    NULL                                                     AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
    NULL                                                     AS fo_comments,
    NULL                                                     AS pec_recusals,
    NULL                                                     AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
    NULL                                                     AS fx_spot,
    NULL                                                     AS full_amt_cad_mm,
    NULL                                                     AS rejected_deals_reason,
    --------------------------------------
    -- investigate these
    --------------------------------------
    NULL                                                     AS investment_program,
    NULL                                                     AS investment_strategy,
    NULL                                                     AS investment_group,
    NULL                                                     AS tfm_inv_sub_strategy,
    --------------------------------------
    -- helpful debug information
    --------------------------------------
    transactions.transaction_code                            AS transaction_code,
    'credit_investment_private_trusted_dev.cashflows_all_transactions, reference_dev.ci_sentry_security'               AS data_sources_list
    --------------------------------------
FROM
    credit_investment_private_trusted_dev.cashflows_all_transactions transactions
LEFT JOIN
    reference_dev.ci_sentry_security securities
ON
    transactions.security_identifier = securities.security_identifier
WHERE
    CAST(transactions.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-05-11' AS DATE)
AND
    CAST(securities.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-05-11' AS DATE)
AND
    TRY_CAST('2025-05-11' AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE (securities.start_date) AND DATE(securities.end_date)
--AND
--  TRY_CAST(transactions.trade_date AS DATE) >= TRY_CAST('2025-05-11' AS DATE)
-- TODO: confirm if this is just because there is no underlying data
-- or there is problem in the logic
AND
    transactions.transaction_type = 'transaction'
AND
    transactions.is_cancelled = 'False'
AND
    settlement_date = ''

SELECT * FROM (SELECT *

  with ae_temp as (
      select investment_dept, investment_strat, business_date,
             (case when (product_type = 'Equity Swap' and maturity_date = business_date and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0) then abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   when (product_type = 'Equity Swap' and maturity_date = business_date and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0) then 0
                   when (product_type = 'Equity Swap') then abacus_notional_base_ccy + abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   when (product_type = 'Convertible_bond' and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0) then 0 
                   when (product_type = 'Convertible_bond' and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0) then abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   else abacus_pv_base_ccy end
             ) as exposure
      from "risk_prod"."rmv_position"
      where investment_dept = 'Active Equities' and portfolio_type = 'IP' and product_type in ('Common Stock','Common Stock Private','Convertible_bond','Equity Swap','Private Emerging Mkt Fund', 'Synthetic Equity Index','Unit','Pooled Fund Absolute Return','Listed Warrant','Preferred Stock','REIT','Depository Receipt','Leveraged Loans') and long_short = 'LONG'
  ),
  
  analytics as (
      select business_date, node, analytic_name, analytic_value
      from "risk_prod"."rmv_analytics"
      where node in ('Active Equities','Asia','Europe','LatAm','North America','AE Enhanced Beta')
      and portfolio_type = 'IP' 
      and analytic_name in ('10 Year VaR', '10 Year Volatility','2 Year VaR', '2 Year Volatility','5 Year Expected Shortfall') 
      and (confidence_level is null or confidence_level = 0.95)
  )
  
  select q1.business_date, q1.node_name, q1.long_pv, analytics.analytic_name, analytics.analytic_value,
         (analytics.analytic_value / q1.long_pv) * 100 as "% analytics"
  from (
      select ae_temp.business_date, ae_temp.investment_strat as node_name, sum(ae_temp.exposure) as long_pv
      from ae_temp
      group by ae_temp.investment_strat, ae_temp.business_date
  
      union
  
      select ae_temp.business_date, ae_temp.investment_dept as node_name, sum(ae_temp.exposure) as long_pv 
      from ae_temp
      group by ae_temp.investment_dept, ae_temp.business_date
  ) as q1
  right join analytics 
  on q1.business_date = analytics.business_date and q1.node_name = analytics.node
) "custom_sql_query"
LIMIT 0) T LIMIT 0

    ),
  WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI AS
    (SELECT DISTINCT    
        parent.party_name,
        parent.rtg_final,
        COALESCE(ref_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code) AS country,
        parent.gics_sector,
        parent.is_government,
        parent.is_provincial,
        pos.investment_department,
        SUM( COALESCE(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY PARENT.party_name, PARENT.rtg_final ) AS ce_by_party_by_rating,
        SUM( COALESCE(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY PARENT.party_name, pos.investment_department ) AS ce_by_party_by_dept,
        SUM( COALESCE(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY PARENT.party_name ) AS ce_by_party,
        CASE
          WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' AND upper( PARENT.party_name ) LIKE 'PROVINCE OF ONTARIO%' THEN pv * 0.1

              AND upper(PARENT.party_name) IN ('UNITED STATES OF AMERICA', 'CANADA') THEN 0  
          WHEN PARENT.rtg_final IS NULL THEN -1  
          when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$' ) then pv * 0.1
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.075
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.05
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.03
          when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) then pv * 0.025  
          else -2

      from
        radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos,
        total_pv,
        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
        SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
    ),
	adjusted_date AS (
		SELECT
			query_date,
			CASE
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
             pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
             pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
             pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
             pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
         FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

		from

		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency

	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select

		, case

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			select

				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level"

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

				, pnl_4yp_lc

		) perf

				or (

					and scd.split_level = 1

				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (

					and scd.split_level = 2

			)

	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

SELECT
            from_currency as from_currency,
            to_currency as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end,6) as mid_price,
            business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
        WHERE
            from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD'
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            and business_date = Date('2025-06-16')
        UNION
        Select
            MainTable.to_currency as from_currency,
            'CAD' as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then
                MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                end,6) as calc_mid_price,
            MainTable.business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
        Left Join
        (
            SELECT
                case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end as mid_price,
                business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = Date('2025-06-16')
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
        ) as CAD_Rate on
            MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
        WHERE
            MainTable.business_date = Date('2025-06-16')
            and MainTable.from_currency = 'USD'
            and MainTable.mid_price != 0
            and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            order by business_date,from_currency

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "business_date_int", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), asset_class_clean as (
	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		asset_class_base
	where
		business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		/*and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD', '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) )
		and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) )*/

WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Credit'

WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Future Offset' 
ELSE NULL END AS Leg_Type

,CASE

  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap fixed leg' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap floating leg' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap floating leg' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Short'

  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Fixed' AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'

  --Others
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'

    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long' 
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'

    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD',  'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD',  'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    ELSE NULL
END AS "Contract_Direction"

,CASE WHEN l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short' WHEN l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
      ELSE NULL END AS "Leg_Direction"
,l.underlying_index_name AS "Underlying_Index"

      WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.abor_security_number,'-999')
      when m.abor_security_type_name='Equity Future' then concat('CPP',cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))

,DATE_DIFF('day',l.business_date,date(substr(m.abor_maturity_date,1,11))) AS "Term_To_Maturity"
/*Leg no but need the logic to map*/

WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'IRS IR' THEN
    case when esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap fixed leg' then 'Fixed' else 'Floating' end
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Credit' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Financing' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT','FXFORWARD','FXNDF')
AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Base'

WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no <> 2 THEN 'Fixed Income'
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Financing' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no <> 2 THEN 'Future'
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Future Offset'

,CASE

  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap floating leg' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap floating leg' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Short'
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap fixed leg' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Short'

  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Fixed' AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Floating' AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Floating' AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'

  --Others
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'

    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'

    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD',  'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD',  'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'

SELECT aa.business_date,

                                aa.option_symbol,
                                aa.strike_price/1000.0 as strike,
                                aa.expiration_date,
                                aa.open_interest,
                                aa.call_put_flag,
                                aa.best_bid,
                                aa.best_ask,
                                aa.vega, 
                                bb.close_price as SpotRef, 
                                aa.strike_price/1000.0/bb.close_price as Mny
                                from market.om_option_price aa
                                join market.om_security_price bb
                        on
                            bb.security_id=aa.security_id and bb.business_date = aa.business_date
                        where
                            aa.security_id = 110012
                            AND aa.business_date >= DATE '2025-06-13'
                            AND aa.business_date <= DATE '2025-06-13'
                            AND date_diff('day', aa.business_date, aa.expiration_date) > 5
                            AND aa.best_bid > 0
                            AND aa.best_ask > 0
                            AND aa.special_settlement_flag <> '1'
                            AND (
                                (aa.best_bid + aa.best_ask) / 2 >= CASE 
                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'C' THEN GREATEST(bb.close_price - aa.strike_price / 1000.0, 0)
                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'P' THEN GREATEST(aa.strike_price / 1000.0 - bb.close_price, 0)
                                END
                            )
                        ORDER BY 
                            business_date, expiration_date, call_put_flag, strike ASC

			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,

WITH
earliest_business_date_of_given_month AS (
    SELECT MIN(business_date) AS business_date
    FROM market_qa.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE rate_type_code = 'SR'
        AND MONTH(business_date) = MONTH(DATE('2025-06-16'))
        AND YEAR(business_date) = YEAR(DATE('2025-06-16'))
),
fx_rates_usd_to_cad AS (
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        (CASE WHEN (UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y') THEN (1 / mid_price) ELSE mid_price END) exchange_rate
    FROM
        market_qa.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE from_currency = 'USD'
        AND to_currency = 'CAD'
        AND mid_price IS NOT NULL
        AND mid_price <> 0
        AND rate_type_code = 'SR'
),
fx_rates_usd_to_local AS (
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        from_currency from_currency,
        to_currency to_currency,
        (CASE WHEN (UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y') THEN (1 / mid_price) ELSE mid_price END) exchange_rate
    FROM
        market_qa.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE from_currency = 'USD'
        AND mid_price IS NOT NULL
        AND mid_price <> 0
        AND rate_type_code = 'SR'
),
fx_rates_cad_to_local AS (
    SELECT
        usd_to_cl.business_date business_date,
        'CAD' from_currency,
        to_currency to_currency,
        ROUND((usd_to_cad.exchange_rate / usd_to_cl.exchange_rate), 8) exchange_rate
    FROM
        (fx_rates_usd_to_local usd_to_cl
        INNER JOIN fx_rates_usd_to_cad usd_to_cad ON (usd_to_cl.business_date = usd_to_cad.business_date))
    UNION
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        'CAD' from_currency,
        'USD' to_currency,
        exchange_rate exchange_rate
    FROM
        fx_rates_usd_to_cad usd_to_cad
)
SELECT
    business_date,
    from_currency,
    to_currency,
    exchange_rate
FROM fx_rates_cad_to_local

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"

	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select

				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level"

				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id

				, "level"

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on

			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */

				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (

					and scd.split_level = 1

				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)

	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'

		/* VALUE */

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

		from

	cross join unnest (

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'

	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select

		, case

		, case

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			select

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

			 */
			union all

				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level"

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

				, pnl_4yp_lc

		) perf
		on

		where

				or (

					and scd.split_level = 1

				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2

			)

	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

	/* DATA PULLED:

	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

WITH

        SELECT

            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-05')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_infra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_infra_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))

/* cppi::231c713a765464f4eff6c8c1a1764dfc4947fc00fb34d38db5cd790de0542265 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 16
		AND hour between 01 and 02
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-16 01:03:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

GROUP BY
    index_red_code, index_ticker, index_series, index_version, index_tenor
ORDER BY
    index_series ASC, index_version ASC

/* cppi::b36f66c7ce460e7dedcdba26b3886d07d9eaca0fcb03f224bfc3274c99a542b7 */
WITH
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM quarter_end
           )
),
private_real_estate_model_portfolios AS ( -- "private" model portoflios that are actually part of listed portfolio 
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Real Estate'                                 AS investment_group,
            'Listed Real Estate'                          AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Private Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
        AND mp.model_portfolio_id IN  ('RIALIA02', 'RIFLAM', 'RIESRKS', 'RIRELCP', 'RIUNITE')
),
listed_real_estate_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Real Estate'                                 AS investment_group,
            'Listed Real Estate'                          AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Listed Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Infrastructure'                              AS investment_group,
            'Listed Infrastructure'                       AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4         IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5         IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Sustainable Energies'                        AS investment_group,
            'Listed Sustainable Energy Group'             AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4     IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')
                AND pif.investmentstructurelevel6     IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel7     IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT *
       FROM private_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios
),
latest_version_of_abor_transactions AS (
     SELECT t.abor_security_id,
            t.model_portfolio_id,
            t.abor_transaction_number,
            MAX(CAST(t.business_date AS DATE)) AS business_date
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
      WHERE t.transaction_cancellation_flag  = 'Active'
        AND t.elementary_transaction_code   IN ('Buy', 'Sell' ,'CapRed', 'BuyRaloc', 'SellRaloc')
        AND t.model_portfolio_id            IN (SELECT model_portfolio_id FROM listed_real_assets_model_portfolios)
   GROUP BY t.abor_transaction_number,
            t.abor_security_id,
            t.model_portfolio_id
),
abor_transactions AS (
     SELECT t.abor_transaction_number,
            t.model_portfolio_id,
            t.abor_security_id,
            CAST(t.period_closure_date AS DATE)                                      AS period_closure_date,
            CAST(t.business_date AS DATE)                                            AS business_date,
            t.elementary_transaction_code,
            t.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
            t.current_value_portfolio_currency,
            CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('Buy', 'BuyRaloc')
                 THEN payment_amount_portfolio_currency 
                 ELSE 0 
            END                                                                      AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
            CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('Sell', 'SellRaloc', 'CapRed')
                 THEN current_value_portfolio_currency 
                 ELSE 0 
            END                                                                      AS permanent_roc_historical
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
 INNER JOIN latest_version_of_abor_transactions lt
         ON t.abor_security_id            = lt.abor_security_id
        AND t.model_portfolio_id          = lt.model_portfolio_id
        AND t.abor_transaction_number     = lt.abor_transaction_number
        AND CAST(t.business_date AS DATE) = lt.business_date
),
listed_deals AS (
     SELECT CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                AS business_date,
            h.abor_security_id                           AS investment_code,
            mp.model_portfolio_id                        AS model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            h.abor_security_name                         AS investment_name,
            h.abor_security_name                         AS investment_aggregate_name,
            h.abor_security_name                         AS allocation_name,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                 AS cppib_ownership_percentage,
            CASE WHEN mp.business_unit = 'Listed Real Estate'
                 THEN 'Other'
                 ELSE 'Minority'
            END                                          AS investment_structure,
            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                        AS investment_stage,
            s.country_of_exposure_name                   AS geographic_focus,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_3      AS sector_focus,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_4      AS sub_sector_focus,
            mp.investment_department,
            mp.investment_group,
            mp.business_unit                             AS business_unit,
            h.quotation_currency_code                    AS local_reporting_currency,
            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                        AS realized_or_unrealized,    -- need to figure out how to derive
            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                        AS investment_count,          -- need to ask sophia
            mp.developed_or_emerging                     AS developed_emerging_country,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name AS investment_manager,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                 AS occupied_area,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                 AS total_area,
            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                        AS active_or_liquidated
       FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main h
 INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp
         ON h.model_portfolio_id          = mp.model_portfolio_id
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
  LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities s
         ON h.abor_security_id            = s.abor_security_id
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(s.business_date AS DATE)
  LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications asec
         ON s.cppib_sec_id                = CAST(asec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
        AND CAST(s.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(asec.business_date AS DATE)
)
  SELECT business_date                                                 AS "Buinsess Date",
         investment_code                                               AS "Investment Code",
         model_portfolio_name                                          AS "Herbi Name",
         investment_name                                               AS "Legal Entity Name",
         investment_aggregate_name                                     AS "Investment Name",
